Native SKAB evaluation covered 319 windows from 10 disjoint test experiments. GDN had process-window average precision 0.765, event recall 0.500 and false-positive fraction 0.044 at nominal 5\%. Median delay among detected events was 36.0 seconds, with 5 undetected events. It retained 16 process alerts while attribution abstained. These labels support no sensor-localization claim.
